docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A course in German for English speakers: the lessons of each level are set in a German-speaking city and teach conversation, vocabulary and grammar step by step (articles and cases, verbs and tenses, word order), with readings, exercises and review lessons, and appendices on pronunciation and grammar.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

German, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
